lessons.title: Reconcile Scope, Time & Capacity

lessons.exercise: On your own project, produce Roadmap briefing and Release roadmap — so that: A published roadmap and release plan, briefed to each audience, with a review cadence.
lessons.prompt:
I'm working through "Publish & Align the Roadmap" (Plan → Roadmap & Release Planning) on my own project. Act as my assistant: draft and check, I decide.

Goal: Make sure everyone affected reads the same roadmap and knows how it will change.
Done looks like: A published roadmap and release plan, briefed to each audience, with a review cadence.

I'll attach or paste: Release roadmap; Release plan; Stakeholder map.

Work through these steps with me, one at a time:
1. Tailor views per audience → Roadmap briefing
2. Brief stakeholders & sites → Briefing log
3. Objections resolved? (a decision — give me the options and a recommendation; I make the call)
4. Publish the roadmap → Release roadmap
5. Schedule the monthly roadmap review

Produce: Roadmap briefing; Release roadmap. Use clear headings I can paste into my document.

Before you finish, check it against: Every audience in the stakeholder map briefed; Confidence shown per horizon; Every audience briefed.

Ask me for anything you need instead of guessing. Keep it specific to my project.
